avis.texte: I really enjoyed this product. It applies really easily and absorbs into my skin quickly. A little goes a long way and it feels so nice on my skin— not greasy, just moisturized. There's a light scent that's barely noticeable and just plain smelling, so I appreciate that.

First Aid Beauty Ultra Repair Retinol eye cream is formulated with retinol, squalane and ceramides and claims to be designed for sensitive skin. Only a small amount is needed and should be applied morning and night. I have been using this product as directed and find it to have a lovely soft and smooth texture that sinks into skin quickly. While I'm finding that it does a very good job at softening the dryness under my eyes, one thing I would like to point out in my review is that I felt a slight stinging sensation which surprised me since this product is specifically for sensitive skin. The stinging does dissipate fairly quickly, but I just wanted to mention it, and I can only assume that perhaps it has something to do with the retinol ingredient in the product. Other than being aware of that (especially if you have highly sensitive skin ), it really does a good job at softening the delicate under eye skin and smoothing the area. I also found that it works fine under complexion products such as under eye concealer.

Amazing texture that absorbs easily, suitable for fine lines and outer corners of of my eyes. Loving the cute packaging and how well it works with puffiness, redness and zero discomfort with the retinol.
It absorbs into the skin really well, leaves it incredibly soft, and I absolutely love it. I started using it with high expectations and I'm looking forward to seeing excellent results.
I love a lot of FAB products so this was so disappointing. First off, it burned for the first 2 weeks i used it. Lays terribly under makeup. Makes my under eye makeup very patchy.

I'm not sure about this eye cream. I don't like the consistency. After applying it, I feel nothing, you know like firming, moisturized. I already use prescription retinol, so I think I'll stick to a more forming cream, where I can feel it. I'm sure it does something in time. I needed a cream that doesn't clog pores or irritate my eyes. But this just doesn't do it for me.
For the price, no. It burns the delicate skin, crazy that it's for sensitive skin.

This eye cream goes a long way and is incredibly easy to work with! I love the tube it comes in as it's easy to squeeze product out of, and it's not too much product that comes out either! I keep in it my mini fridge so its always cold and soothes any puffiness! I'm turning 37 in a few days and this eye cream keeps my eyes hydrated and my fine lines smooth! I definitely recommend this eye cream!! I didn't feel any grittiness to my product like the others have said… maybe it was a bad batch? Thats why I keep mine cold so it keeps better for longer! Ive been using this for 4 weeks and it's got amazing results!

I have extremely sensitive skin, especially around my eyes, but this eye cream is great. I will say the product burned the first & second time using it, like a tingling sensation, but it didn't cause any redness or irritation besides that feeling. I also do wish it came in a bigger size, but a little product goes a long way!

So I have very sensitive skin and the retinol alternatives I tried proved to be too harsh. On a whim I said "Hey, let's try the stuff these are supposed to take the place of," and am so happy I did. This product doesn't bother my eyes at all and after 2 months of use I can see a significant improvement to my droopy eyelid.

avis.titre: Disappointing and irritating to my eyes
avis.texte: I can feel it is working to tighten but i cannot get past the gritty feeling when its applied. I have found after using it more often my eyes have become sensitive to it. I wake up with puffiness around my eyes causing bags. My eyes are also res and clearly irriteted. I think ill go back to the hydrating eye cream as ive had much more success using that product than this one.

avis.titre: Bring Back the Old Eye Cream PLEASE!
avis.texte: I wanted to like the new eye cream but after 60 days I have determined it is far inferior to the previous eye cream. Not only did it burn, it was so much less moisturizing. I was surprised at how awful it made my eyes look and feel. While I have yet to find a different eye cream (the hyaluronic acid one is not moisturizing enough) for my aging eyes, I will not use this inferior product especially for the price. Please bring back the old retinol eye cream, please. First Aid Beauty is the only company that has skin care products that I love, that work and that don't irritate my skin…until this eye cream came along. I give their other products 5 stars.

avis.titre: So much potential this brand had like10yrsago SIGH
avis.texte: Stop changing all your buyers favorite products to save money. You're ruining your brand, I was OUT when you changed the first serum and kept the old ingredient deck up on site for over a year…. Is it still up? When I saw you did away with the retinol eye cream I just gasped like what do they have left that they haven't ruined yet? You even ruined the hero product. The main cream. It's not the same as it used to be. You guys and IT cosmetics should be holding hands skipping to an eminent demise… there was SOOOO MUCH POTENTIAL FOR GROWTH!!!
Ive been using this for about a week and this eye cream burns when i apply it & also ive noticed it starts peeling.

My skin has become very dry with age. I purchased the bounce boost serum, retinol eye cream and the ultra repair cream to use together. On top of helping with the dry issue, it is doing a good job on the wrinkles. I am very satisfied with the results!
Still gentle, but definitely too much pilling with this new formula. It just pilled or flaked off when I put my eye shadow on. Also felt like my eyelids weren't as lifted. Not happy.

avis.titre: New formula burns and doesn't brighten
avis.texte: As the title states, this new formula burns and stings and isn't even worth it because it doesn't brighten. The previous formula used to brighten my under eye area and leave it very moisturized, this new one dries it out and leaves it dull and tired-looking. I will be looking for a new eye cream and returning this disappointment. I've been using FAB products for years and they really messed up with this product revamp.
Despite claims of being for sensitive skin it, it had the opposite affect on me. It caused burning and dried out my skin.

I definitely believe this worked for all those who gave it a good review but I used it on my undereyes for 3 days (only at night) and had to stop bc it made my skin burn so bad. For me, it surprisingly wasnt red at all but when I'd put on any other products my undereyes would burn. This continued for 4ish days after I'd stopped using it. Maybe I have more sensitive skin than I thought, maybe it was from combining it with other products I use, I dont know. But the glow recipe avocado melt retinol eye cream doesn't do this to me. Maybe it's the concentration of retinol? I've had this experience with one other retinol product in the past. So if you've ever experienced burning from retinol, you might want to skip this one.

I wanted to love this eye cream because I was a die-hard user of the previous formula, but it pills, burns and feels gritty. I cant use it and will have to find a retinol eye cream elsewhere. I'm very disappointed.

avis.titre: Fantastic way to introduce Retinol into a routine
avis.texte: I absolutely adore this Retinol Eye Cream with Squalane + Ceramides eye cream! I have been using it daily and have had no sensitivity or reactions, even though it contains Retinol, which is notorious for being hard on sensitive skin. The fine lines around my eyes have practically disappeared & the eye area stays hydrated so my eyeshadow sits better. The results are noticeable, and a little goes a long way! I highly recommend this eye cream!

First Aid Beauty also has a great new retinol eye cream. The cream is Retinol Eye Cream with Squalane + Ceramides and it's a multi action cream. The eye cream helps with the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. It also helps smooth out and hydrate the eye area because it has a slow release retinol system that diminishes redness and irritation. Ever since I started using the retinol eye cream I have noticed that my eye area is hydrated, calm and show less fine lines.

I received this product complimentary from First Aid Beauty in exchange of my honest review. First Aid Beauty's Retinol Eye Cream is a game-changer! It gently yet effectively addresses fine lines, dark circles, and puffiness. My under-eyes look brighter, smoother, and more rested. The cream is lightweight, non-greasy, and perfect for sensitive skin. I've seen a noticeable improvement in just a few weeks! It's now a staple in my skincare routine.

avis.titre: Not for sensitive skin as they say it is
avis.texte: I'm disappointed. I've been using their Retinol eye cream with triple hyaluronic acid for a year now. When I saw this new one I decided to try it since it also says that it's suitable for sensitive skin. I woke up with redness all around my eyes and a burning sensation whenever I washed my face or touched the area. The skin around my eyes was like that for about 5 days. I only used it that one time and put it back in the box. Hoping I can return it. I'm back to using the little bit I have left of their old formula and have NO issues with that one.

avis.titre: Amazing eye cream for fine lines!
avis.texte: I bought this eye cream a week ago, and swear I already see results! It absorbs quickly, leaves no greasy residue, and I can feel it working almost instantly. I would highly recommend this product, as well as any other product, from First Aid!

I love this eye cream it's amazing under my eyes! My eyes look brighter, and they have less fine lines my concealer applies better. I'm very happy with this product. It doesn't dry out my under eyes it's not sticky it's lightweight texture. Over all it's great product! I love everything with retinol!

avis.titre: Start slow, can be a bit drying
avis.texte: I have been using this eye cream for about 3 weeks or so now. The eye cream goes on smoothly and absorbs nicely with no sticky feeling, though I am unable to use it twice a day as I find it a bit drying. Works well under moisturizer, but I do not wear makeup, so unsure how it works underneath concealer or foundation. I haven't seen much result so far, but I know it can take awhile for fine lines, so I will continue to use. This would probably be more helpful as a preventative as opposed to reversing the signs of aging.

This retinol eye cream is gentle around my eyes and instantly hydrates. It is a little sticky at first but then my skin becomes softs. I am using it to help with lines under my eye area and It pairs perfectly with the retinol serum which I am a big fan of as well.
I tried this looking for a new eye cream, but it made my eyes burn. I woke up this morning with red undereyes. I hope it works better for someone else, but its not for me. 😣

I love all FAB products. They always work well with my very sensitive dry skin. This retinol eye cream works well for my eyes and doesn't irritate them. It also works well under makeup which I appreciate. I notice a difference in the fine lines in my under eyes when I use this consistently. I knocked a star off because I do wish it came in pump packaging instead of a squeeze tube. I think this would help preserve the product longer and dispense the right amount. Still, I recommend this eye cream! This product was gifted to me from First Aid Beauty in exchange for my honest review.

I'm loving this retinol eye cream, it is lightweight and absorbs nicely in the under-eye area. Many people are afraid of using retinol but this is safe for sensitive skin. It did not cause any irritation to my eyes. It is very hydrating and reduces wrinkles around the eye area. I love using this retinol eye cream with the retinol complex serum.

This new retinol eye cream has a dense texture, sorta thicker than I'm accustomed to. It dabs on nicely but unfortunately for me I immediately experience pilling ~ so much so that I've got kinda wipe most of it off? I tried using it different ways like under moisturizer or over serums, etc. I was able to use on completely dry skin which isn't really ideal for me and after a few hours it would burn my sensitive eyes! I'm so bummed I could not make it work for me. I do appreciate the ingredients and that it initially felt so creamy & hydrating.

avis.titre: A keeper in my skincare routine
avis.texte: This is so silky and glides on easily. It absorbs instantly locking in moisture and smoothing my fine lines. Just buy it! You will love it.

I'm A great and gentle eye cream that I can use for my pm skincare routine. I use a small amount of it and it has helped keep my undereyes nicely hydrated and plump which is great for the small wrinkles around the eyes. It absorbs nicely and it when I wake up as I don't tend to do am skincare, it leaves a great base for makeup which is still plump and hydrated and won't make my undereyes look dry once adding foundation and powder.

I received this about a month ago and I have been using it every single night. Every single day, I love the way it makes my under eyes feel I don't wake up with dryness. It's almost like it's actually healing the fine lines around my eyes, especially the crow'stweet. My ladies over 30 can understand. Especially my mom friends you got it. We need to look like we've slept and this is the product you need! I love the ingredients safe for sensitive skin and I have extremely sensitives skin. MUST ADD TO YOUR ROUTINE!!!! The way it gives that healthy hydration is everything!!!
Absolutely love this new eye cream in my routine! It feels wonderful when using it in the undereye area. Will definitely be keeping it as a staple.
